name: MarsCon
blurb: The largest sci-fi/fantasy convention in Virginia's Tidewater area, with author, gaming, music and cosplay guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'MarsCon 2027... Meet the MarsCon 2027 Guests of Honor'; hotel booking link's $99/night MarsCon group-code rate 'valid through 1/9/2027' (consistent with a mid-January con, not the unconfirmed February reading of an earlier hotel-widget check)

notes: The homepage/guest pages never state the convention's own days in plain text (only the hotel rate deadline and address); dates were confirmed via web search of secondary convention-listing sites plus the Jan 9, 2027 rate-deadline cross-check. Two guest pages exist for 2027 ('guests' = Guests of Honor + Featured Guests, '2027-other-guests' = additional author guests); both are cited as separate lineup entries. Skipped one duplicate image of Gray Rinehart on the second guest page (same person picked once).
